sources.title: Introduction of RoBERTa Model - GeeksforGeeks
sources.snippet: RoBERTa (Robustly Optimized BERT Pretraining Approach) is an encoder-only transformer model developed by Meta AI to improve the performance of the BERT model through optimized pretraining strategies. sources.snippet: RoBERTa (Robustly Optimized BERT Pretraining Approach) is an open-source natural language processing model released in July 2019 by researchers at Facebook AI (now Meta AI) and the University of Washington that reproduces and retrains BERT with a better recipe and shows BERT was "significantly undertrained."
